# Stampede USA

> Digital marketing agency serving small businesses across the Tampa Bay area
> of Florida. Websites, paid ads, local SEO, and AI-powered lead systems, with
> every engagement scoped around one outcome: qualified leads that turn into
> revenue.

Owner-operated. Clients work directly with the owner rather than an account
manager. Based in Zephyrhills, Florida (Pasco County — one of the four core
counties of the Tampa–St. Petersburg–Clearwater metro), serving the wider
Tampa Bay region as a service-area business.

**Contact:** (813) 214-2292 · charge@stampedeusa.com · https://www.stampedeusa.com

## What they do

- **Website design and optimization** — audits, redesigns, and rebuilds built for speed, search, and conversion rather than appearance alone.
- **AI automation and lead systems** — automated lead nurture, follow-up, and reporting so leads are not lost between the enquiry and the callback.
- **Google and social ads management** — search, social, and display, with tight targeting and continuous testing.
- **Local SEO and Google Maps ranking** — Business Profile optimization, citations, reviews, on-page SEO and schema for Tampa Bay service areas.
- **Paid media and creative** — ad creative and copy, shipped fast, with losers cut quickly.
- **Offers, messaging and positioning** — sharpening the offer so prospects understand why to choose this business.
- **Marketing analytics and reporting** — dashboards built around leads, revenue, cost and ROI rather than impressions.
- **Marketing spend audit** — finding wasted spend in existing vendor contracts and tooling.

## Who they work with

Owner-operated and small-team businesses, typically doing $200K–$5M in revenue,
that are ready to scale but have no marketing department. Common industries:
home services, contractors and landscaping, professional services, health and
wellness, restaurants and hospitality, retail and e-commerce, auto services,
and real estate.

## Service area

Tampa, St. Petersburg, Clearwater, Brandon, Riverview, Wesley Chapel,
Land O'Lakes, Lutz, New Tampa, Zephyrhills, Dade City, and the surrounding
Tampa Bay area. Select clients outside the region are taken for digital-only
engagements.

## Pricing

Published rather than quote-on-request. Website projects typically start around
$2,500. Ongoing monthly retainers start at $800. Scope is priced per engagement,
with a straight number given upfront. Monthly retainers are month-to-month after
the first 90 days; there are no long-term contracts.

## How engagements work

1. **Free growth audit** — a look at the business, market and current marketing. Roughly 30 minutes.
2. **Custom strategy** — if it is a fit, a plan scoped to goals, budget and timeline, approved before any spend.
3. **Execute and optimize** — launch, measure, cut what fails, scale what works.

Their stated method is "Listen. Discuss. Execute." — understand the business
before pitching, agree the plan explicitly, then move fast and report honestly.
